questions.question_text: Why is eating a meal while running or watching TV rapidly correlated with indigestion and stomach discomfort?
options: A) Distracted eating reduces mastication thoroughness and impairs parasympathetic digestive secretion.
B) Watching TV turns stomach acid into ice.
C) Running creates extra teeth in the throat.
D) Food dissolves into air before reaching stomach.
questions.correct_answer: A) Distracted eating reduces mastication thoroughness and impairs parasympathetic digestive secretion.
questions.detailed_explanation:
HINT: Digestion requires thorough mechanical chewing and calm nervous system activation.

DETAILED STEP-BY-STEP REASONING:
Swallowing unchewed food chunks overburdens the stomach. Physical stress or mental distraction inhibits parasympathetic signals needed for optimal saliva, gastric acid, and digestive enzyme secretion.

questions.question_text: Which enzyme in the human digestive system is responsible for breaking down complex starch into maltose sugar in the mouth?
options: Pepsin
Salivary Amylase
Trypsin
Lipase
questions.correct_answer: Salivary Amylase
questions.detailed_explanation:
[HINT / CONCEPT KEY] Digestion starts in the oral cavity.
[DETAILED STEP-BY-STEP REASONING] Salivary amylase secreted by salivary glands initiates starch breakdown into simpler maltose sugars during mastication.
[CORE TAKEAWAY] Mastication and salivary enzymes prepare carbohydrates for stomach and intestinal absorption.
